title: PEEP trial: pulmonary ARDS, non-recruiter (R/I, decremental trial)
summary: Consolidated units that do not open at protective pressures. The R/I release recovers only the compliance-predicted volume (R/I ≈ 0) and the decremental trial finds its best compliance at a low PEEP: higher PEEP only overdistends the baby lung.
objectives: Measure R/I: the release volume equals Crs,low × ΔPEEP, so Vrec ≈ 0.
Run the decremental trial: compliance improves as PEEP falls (overdistension side only).
Compare the end-inspiratory PL from the balloon at each PEEP step.
